The import still fails despite returncode 0 — likely no network access. Let me check pip output more directly.

```python
import sys, subprocess
for args in (['-m','pip','--version'], ['-m','pip','install','pyscf']):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable]+args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    print("CMD:", args, "| rc:", r.returncode)
    print("STDOUT:", r.stdout[-2000:])
    print("STDERR:", r.stderr[-2000:])
    print("-"*60)
```
